requirements.checkable: All quote-token amounts across RaffleFactory and Raffle (ENTRY_PRICE, grossAmount, unsettledPot, remainingRefundLiability, winnerProceeds, sponsorProceeds, and protocolFees) are denominated and transferred in raw 6-decimal units without additional decimal scaling.
requirements.quote: Quote-token amounts use raw six-decimal units.

requirements.checkable: Every basis-point calculation in the protocol (protocol fee and cash-winner proceeds in Raffle._settleWinningTicket) uses OpenZeppelin Math.mulDiv with floor rounding (rounding down).

During winning-ticket settlement in Raffle._settleWinningTicket, sponsorProceeds is assigned the exact remainder of unsettledPot after subtracting protocolFee (for NftWon) or subtracting both protocolFee and cashAmount (for CashWon).
requirements.quote: the sponsor receives the remaining raw units after winner and protocol allocations.

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.BPS is defined as 10_000 and is passed as the denominator to every basis-point calculation in the protocol (protocolFee and cashAmount in Raffle._settleWinningTicket).
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Denominator used for every global protocol basis-point rate.
    uint256 internal constant BPS = 10_000;

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS is defined as 500 and Raffle._settleWinningTicket computes protocolFees as Math.mulDiv(grossPot, RaffleConstants.PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS, RaffleConstants.BPS), equal to 500 / 10,000 (5%) of gross sales rounded down.
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Global protocol fee rate: 500 basis points, or 5% of gross sales.
    uint256 internal constant PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS = 500;

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.CASH_WINNER_BPS is defined as 8000 and, when status is CashWon, Raffle._settleWinningTicket computes winnerProceeds as Math.mulDiv(grossPot, RaffleConstants.CASH_WINNER_BPS, RaffleConstants.BPS), equal to 8,000 / 10,000 (80%) of gross sales rounded down.
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Cash-result winner rate: 8,000 basis points, or 80% of gross sales.
    uint256 internal constant CASH_WINNER_BPS = 8000;

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.ENTRY_PRICE is defined as 1_000_000, exposed via Raffle.ENTRY_PRICE, and used as the per-entry multiplier in Raffle.buyEntries, Raffle.refundTickets, and Raffle.grossSales.
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Global entry price: exactly 1,000,000 raw six-decimal quote-token units, or one USDC.
    uint256 internal constant ENTRY_PRICE = 1_000_000;

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.QUOTE_TOKEN_DECIMALS is defined as 6 and RaffleFactory.constructor queries IERC20Metadata(quoteToken_).decimals(), reverting if the call fails or returns a value not equal to RaffleConstants.QUOTE_TOKEN_DECIMALS.
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Decimal precision required from the immutable quote token.
    uint8 internal constant QUOTE_TOKEN_DECIMALS = 6;

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.MAX_REFUND_TICKET_BATCH_SIZE is defined as 100 and Raffle.refundTickets reverts with InvalidTicketBatchSize when ticketIds.length is 0 or exceeds RaffleConstants.MAX_REFUND_TICKET_BATCH_SIZE.
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Refund execution is bounded by tickets, while each ticket may represent any uint128 entry count.
    uint256 internal constant MAX_REFUND_TICKET_BATCH_SIZE = 100;

requirements.checkable: Raffle.buyEntries accepts any positive uint128 entryCount that does not overflow uint128 totalEntries for a single ticket, and Raffle.refundTickets refunds the full represented entry range (lastEntry - firstEntry + 1) of each burned ticket regardless of its entry count.
requirements.quote: while each ticket may represent any uint128 entry count.

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.MAX_SALE_DURATION is defined as 30 days, RaffleFactory.createRaffle requires params.endTime > block.timestamp and uint256(params.endTime) - block.timestamp <= RaffleConstants.MAX_SALE_DURATION, and Raffle.buyEntries treats endTime as exclusive by reverting when block.timestamp >= endTime.
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Maximum prospective raffle sale duration, measured from creation to the exclusive sale end.
    uint256 internal constant MAX_SALE_DURATION = 30 days;

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.DRAW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT is defined as 2 days, Raffle.drawRequestDeadline() returns uint256(endTime) + RaffleConstants.DRAW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT, and Raffle.requestDraw() only succeeds for a sold Active raffle when endTime <= block.timestamp < drawRequestDeadline().
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Duration after sale end during which a sold raffle may initiate its draw, in seconds.
    uint256 internal constant DRAW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 2 days;

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.DRAW_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT is defined as 2 days, Raffle.callbackDeadline() returns uint256(drawRequestedAt) + RaffleConstants.DRAW_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT once a request is recorded, and Raffle.fulfillRandomWords ignores callbacks when block.timestamp >= callbackDeadline().
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Duration after an accepted request during which its authenticated callback may resolve, in seconds.
    uint256 internal constant DRAW_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT = 2 days;

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.VRF_CALLBACK_GAS_LIMIT is defined as 300_000, exposed as callbackGasLimit on RaffleFactory and Raffle, and passed with numWords = 1 to VRF wrapper pricing and request functions while Raffle.fulfillRandomWords requires randomWords.length == 1.
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Gas-unit limit requested for the single-word Chainlink callback.
    uint32 internal constant VRF_CALLBACK_GAS_LIMIT = 300_000;

requirements.checkable: RaffleConstants.VRF_REQUEST_CONFIRMATIONS is defined as 30, exposed as requestConfirmations on RaffleFactory and Raffle, and passed as the requestConfirmations argument to requestRandomnessPayInNative in Raffle.requestDraw().
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Block confirmations requested from Chainlink before callback fulfillment.
    uint16 internal constant VRF_REQUEST_CONFIRMATIONS = 30;
